items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now Did you work for a time with Bus Moten? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, and sometimes he would play accordion

ctx.x: Well, McShann wasn't too happy because most of the time I had the band. In other words, McShann was being harrassed by the Army. I shouldn't say being har-rassed, but everytime you looked, they were calling him down for induction.
Well, just turning back now, what have we got to fill in finish before McShann? Now Did you work for a time with Bus Moten? Bus was playing piano, was he?
Yeah, and sometimes he would play accordion, you know. Sometimes he would take jobs where there wasn't a piano, then he'd take an accordion and play it.
